method: FFmpeg ebur128 true peak at native rate; band RMS via two-pole high/lowpass and8kHz analysis decode. 100ms nonoverlapping block maxima are conservative time-density comparisons, not simultaneous perceptual masking measurements.
limitations: No audition; warning masking and device variation require listening.

loop_validation.method: Circular note tails and echo. Exact decoded48s with no extra silence; boundary step below internal musical transients. Perceptual seam not auditioned.

mix_proposal.warning_duck_scope: Engineering approved: immediate -12dB duck during authoritative volley_warning, acid_warning, pressure_warning and last.75s recovery closing tell;200ms release to normal. Use greatest attenuation min(dialogue-4dB, warning-12dB), never additive. Freeze envelope while paused. No SFX gain changes.
mix_proposal.warning_margin: At gain-28, music max100ms full-36.32/mid-40.93/low-39.51; acid warning max full-30.44/mid-32.68; pressure/groan low approx-27.3. Numeric margins do not certify perception.
mix_proposal.other_sources: Swarmmax RMS-35.25; weapon shot55ms RMS-24.74 peak-22.5. Strong shot transients remain competing sound; no unauthorized weapon/swarm changes.

reproducibility.codec_note: Vorbis container serial can vary across encoding; final frozen file SHA identifies exact delivery.

aggregate_peak_bound.method: Conservative aligned absolute peak sum, not measured simultaneous gameplay. Three nonterminal boss voices at-17dBFS max each (warning/hurt/effect); death cancels others. Vorbis truepeak-1.7 plus musicgain-16; swarm renderedpeak-18 plusgain-8; one generated weapon tone amplitude.075.
aggregate_peak_bound.scope_limit: This bound excludes additional creature hit/death voices, hero hurt/death, doors/dispenser and other simultaneous sources. It does not certify global Master no-clipping under every game state. Engineering runtime stress test and permitted listening remain required.
